title: bupleurum falcatum f. scorzonerifolium
intro: Bupleurum falcatum f. scorzonerifolium, commonly known as Chinese Thorowax or Korean Bupleurum, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) and a variety of the Asian species Bupleurum falcatum. It has been traditionally used in Asian medicine, particularly in Chinese and Korean herbal remedies, to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Chinese Thorowax include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and boosting the immune system, while its therapeutic actions include hepatoprotective, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
